case_analysis.apparent_benchmark_claim: The case appears to claim success when the agent approves all pending Venmo payment requests received in this or the last month and withdraws the remaining Venmo balance to the card ending in 1102.
case_analysis.actual_checked_outcome: The released machinery loads task `ccf4b82_2` from the same `specs.json`, loads the same ground truth and `test_data`, compares the task-input start state against that experiment/task's retained end-state DBs, runs the 11 registered `with test(requirement)` checks in `official/ground_truth/evaluation.py`, and marks success exactly when `TestTracker.pass_count == TestTracker.num_tests`; our worker then serializes that tracker and maps `tracker.success` directly to the released label.
case_analysis.target_construction_review: `Task.load` reads the exact task instruction and starting models for `ccf4b82_2`, and `GroundTruth.load` reads the same task's answer/public/private/test data. `evaluate_task` then pairs that fixed start state with the retained experiment/task end state under the same task id.
case_analysis.evaluator_oracle_review: The evaluator's operative oracle is the 11 registered tests in `official/ground_truth/evaluation.py`; `TestTracker` only registers outcomes on `with test(requirement)` exit and computes success as full conjunction. case_analysis.reward_wiring_aggregation_review: There is no separate reward predicate: `run_official_job` calls `evaluate_task`, serializes the returned tracker, and records `tracker.success`; `run_slot` only reports that summary, and `Metric` aggregates across tasks without changing any individual record's success.

official_benchmark_assessment.description: The official evaluator is a same-outcome but weaker operationalization because its final card-balance check permits a 0.51 tolerance instead of enforcing an exact withdrawn-balance match from the instruction. checklist_and_case_packet_assessment.description: The frozen checklist mirrors the 11 official registered tests and their conjunctive aggregation, and the stricter exact-withdraw condition is kept in `stronger` exactly as the case packet requires rather than being folded into native success.
